papers.title_en: Impact of Neural network-quantified musical groove on cyclists’ joint coordination and muscle synergy: a repeated measures study
papers.title_zh: 神经网络量化音乐律动对自行车骑行者关节协调和肌肉协同的影响：一项重复测量研究
papers.journal_tier: 康复医学1区/工程：生物医学2区/神经科学2区 TOP
papers.tldr_en: High-groove music promotes more coordinated movement patterns during cycling through two key mechanisms: optimized joint coordination, particularly in proximal–distal (hip-ankle) and axial (pelvis-torso) linkages, and reorganization of neuromuscular control strategies evidenced by increased synergy complexity and selective activation of postural stabilizers (SOL).
papers.abstract_en: While music is known to influence exercise performance through auditory-motor coupling, the biomechanical mechanisms by which musical groove—characterized by rhythmic drive and movement-inducing qualities—modulates cycling coordination remain poorly understood. This study investigates how groove levels systematically alter lower extremity kinematics and neuromuscular control during high-torque cycling. Twenty-four well-trained, right-handed cyclists completed high-torque cycling trials under three counterbalanced conditions: metronome (control), low-groove (LG), and high-groove (HG) music, with groove levels objectively classified by a validated deep learning model (R2 = 0.85). papers.abstract_zh: 众所周知，音乐通过听觉-运动耦合影响运动表现，但音乐律动（其特点是节奏驱动和运动诱导性）调节自行车骑行协调的生物力学机制仍知之甚少。本研究旨在探讨在承受高扭矩的骑行过程中，不同律动水平如何系统地改变下肢运动学和神经肌肉控制。二十四名训练有素的右撇子自行车骑行者在三种平衡条件（节拍器（对照）、低律动（LG）和高律动（HG）音乐）下完成了高扭矩骑行试验。

papers.title_en: Optical Marker-Based Motion Capture of the Human Spine: A Scoping Review of Study Design and Outcomes
papers.title_zh: 基于光学标记点的人体脊柱运动捕捉：一项研究设计与结果的范围审查
papers.tldr_en: A review of the methods used to assess spine biomechanics using motion capture systems showed that Plug-in-Gait is the most used marker set and the lumbar spine is the segment that generates the most interest because of its high mobility and function as a weight supporter.
papers.abstract_en: Biomechanical analysis of the human spine is crucial to understanding injury patterns. Motion capture technology has gained attention due to its non-invasive nature. Nevertheless, traditional motion capture studies consider the spine a single rigid segment, although its alignment changes during movement. Moreover, guidelines that indicate where markers should be placed for a specific exercise do not exist. This study aims to review the methods used to assess spine biomechanics using motion capture systems to determine the marker sets used, the protocols used, the resulting parameters, the analysed activities, and the characteristics of the studied populations. PRISMA guidelines were used to perform a Scoping Review using SCOPUS and Web of Science databases. Fifty-six journal and conference articles from 1997 to 2023 were considered for the analysis. papers.abstract_zh: 人体脊柱的生物力学分析对于理解损伤模式至关重要。运动捕捉技术因其非侵入性而受到关注。然而，传统的运动捕捉研究将脊柱视为一个单一的刚性节段，尽管其在运动过程中对齐方式会发生变化。此外，针对特定运动的标记点放置指南尚不存在。本研究旨在综述使用运动捕捉系统评估脊柱生物力学的方法，以确定所使用的标记点集、协议、得出的参数。

papers.title_en: Clinical applications of wearable sensor-based gait analysis in athletes: a systematic review for injury prevention and rehabilitation
papers.title_zh: 基于可穿戴传感器的步态分析在运动员中的临床应用：一项用于损伤预防和康复的系统综述
papers.journal: BMC Sports Science Medicine and Rehabilitation
papers.journal_tier: 康复医学2区/运动科学3区
papers.tldr_en: Evaluating the clinical efficacy of wearable sensor–based gait analysis for injury prevention in athletes, examining its role in rehabilitation monitoring and clinical decision-making, and identifying methodological limitations and future research priorities required for standardized clinical integration identifies key challenges.
papers.abstract_en: Gait analysis is fundamental for optimizing athletic performance and mitigating injury risks in sports medicine. While traditional laboratory assessments offer insights, the emergence of wearable sensor technology provides novel opportunities for objective, real-time gait evaluation in ecologically valid settings. This systematic review aims to (1) evaluate the clinical efficacy of wearable sensor–based gait analysis for injury prevention in athletes (2), examine its role in rehabilitation monitoring and clinical decision-making, and (3) identify methodological limitations and future research priorities required for standardized clinical integration. Adhering to PRISMA 2020 guidelines, a systematic search was conducted across MEDLINE, Web of Science, Scopus, and Embase from inception to May 31st, 2025. papers.abstract_zh: 步态分析对于优化运动表现和降低运动医学中的损伤风险至关重要。传统的实验室评估提供了见解，而可穿戴传感器技术的出现为在生态有效环境中进行客观、实时的步态评估提供了新的机会。本系统综述旨在 (1) 评估基于可穿戴传感器的步态分析在运动员损伤预防中的临床疗效，(2) 审查其在康复监测和临床决策中的作用，以及 (3) 识别方法学局限性和未来研究方向。

papers.title_en: Building for the Future: A Systematic Review of the Effects of Eccentric Resistance Training on Measures of Physical Performance in Youth Athletes
papers.title_zh: 面向未来：离心抗阻训练对青少年运动员身体表现指标影响的系统综述
papers.tldr_en: The findings of this systematic review support the inclusion of eccentric resistance training in youth athletes to improve measures of muscular strength, jump, sprint and change of direction performance.
papers.abstract_en: Background Eccentric resistance training is recognised as an effective stimulus for enhancing measures of muscular strength and power in adult populations; however, its value in youth athletes is currently not well understood. Objective The aim of this systematic review was to critically appraise the effects of eccentric resistance training on measures of physical performance (i.e. muscular strength, jump, sprint and change of direction) in youth athletes 18 years of age and under. Methods Original journal articles published between 1950 and June 2022 were retrieved from electronic search engines of PubMed, SPORTDiscus and Google Scholar’s advanced search option. Full journal articles investigating the acute and chronic effects of eccentric resistance training on measures of physical performance in youth athletes (i.e. a person 18 years of age or under who competes in sport) were include
papers.abstract_zh: 背景 离心抗阻训练被认为是提高成人肌肉力量和爆发力的有效刺激；然而，其在青少年运动员中的价值目前尚不明确。目的 本系统综述旨在批判性评估离心抗阻训练对18岁及以下青少年运动员身体表现指标（即肌肉力量、跳跃、冲刺和变向）的影响。方法 从电子搜索引擎中检索了1950年至2022年6月期间发表的原始期刊文章。

papers.title_en: Effects of different dietary supplements combined with conditioning training on muscle strength, jump performance, sprint speed, and muscle mass in athletes: a systematic review and network meta-analysis
papers.title_zh: 不同膳食补充剂结合体能训练对运动员肌肉力量、跳跃表现、冲刺速度和肌肉量的影响：一项系统综述和网络荟萃分析
papers.tldr_en: Protein supplementation appears to be the most effective strategy for increasing muscular strength; β-alanine and creatine both improve jump performance, with β-alanine offering marginally superior effectiveness; and creatine is particularly beneficial for sprint speed.
papers.abstract_en: Background As dietary supplements have become integral to meeting athletes’ specialised nutritional requirements, research into their effects on performance has intensified. Yet inconsistent findings leave the efficacy of some supplements—most notably branched-chain amino acids and β-hydroxy-β-methylbutyrate (HMB)—open to debate. To clarify which products offer the greatest benefit, we undertook a systematic review and network meta-analysis aimed at identifying the supplements most effective for athletes, including protein, creatine, β-alanine, HMB, vitamin D, caffeine, and others. Methods PubMed, Web of Science, the Cochrane Library, Embase and SPORTDiscus were searched from database inception to 15 March 2024 for RCTs evaluating the effects of dietary supplements (including but not limited to protein, creatine, β-alanine, HMB, caffeine, and vitamin D) on athletic performance. papers.abstract_zh: 背景 随着膳食补充剂成为满足运动员特殊营养需求不可或缺的一部分，对其性能影响的研究也随之加剧。然而，不一致的研究结果使得某些补充剂（最著名的是支链氨基酸和β-羟基-β-甲基丁酸（HMB））的功效仍存在争议。为了阐明哪些产品能提供最大益处，我们进行了一项系统综述和网络荟萃分析，旨在识别对运动员最有效的补充剂，包括蛋白质、肌酸、β-丙氨酸、HMB、维生素D、咖啡因等。

papers.title_en: Writing High-Quality Case Studies in Sport Science.
papers.title_zh: 运动科学中高质量案例研究的撰写
papers.journal: International Journal of Sports Physiology and Performance
papers.abstract_en:
PURPOSE
Sport-physiology and -performance research often relies on group designs that compare experimental and control groups and/or preintervention and postintervention results. This commentary highlights the key elements of a high-quality case study and provides clear guidelines for readers and authors of the International Journal of Sports Physiology and Performance. We propose 4 essential components. First, case studies should offer relevant and original insights by tackling novel issues and defining a clear purpose. Second, they must employ rigorous methodology, encompassing careful participant selection, comprehensive data collection from diverse sources (eg, interviews, surveys, physiological tests, training diaries, competition data), and deliberate data analysis that explicitly addresses factors influencing performance changes. Third, they should be well structured and engagingl
papers.abstract_zh: 目的 运动生理学和运动表现研究通常依赖于比较实验组与对照组和/或干预前后结果的群组设计。本评论旨在强调高质量案例研究的关键要素，并为《国际运动生理学与表现杂志》的读者和作者提供明确的指导。我们提出了4个基本组成部分。首先，案例研究应通过解决新颖问题和明确研究目的来提供相关且原创的见解。其次，它们必须采用严谨的方法论，包括细致的。
